Trails.Name: Lost in the Woods (Lower) Uphill Route
Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 10:15 AM – We picked up 6 to 8 inches of fresh snow over the last 24 hours, and mostly sunny skies are set to show it off this Tuesday, with a light west-southwest breeze and temperatures in the teens, so bundle up! 5 lifts are spinning today with access to 10+ trails, conditions permitting. Look for soft, fresh snow on the groomers, with some wind-affected snow in exposed areas. Fresh snow can hide early-season obstacles. Stick to open, groomed trails and ski and ride with caution. A major storm rolls in Wednesday and is expected to continue through Thursday, so keep an eye on our Storm Tracker. If this upcoming storm delivers, our teams are planning to significantly expand terrain and will work to have lifts open out of Canyon Lodge by this Saturday. There is NO UPHILL SKIING OR SKINNING ACCESS anywhere on the resort at this time.

Conditions and Visibility: Mostly sunny, cold and a light west-southwest breeze. Expect soft, fresh snow on groomed runs, with firmer, wind-affected snow in exposed spots. Bright light and fresh snow call for a sunny-day lens and sunscreen.
Lift Status: Broadway Express (1), Stump Alley Express (2), Unbound Express (6), Discovery Express (11) and the Lower Panorama Gondola are open today, conditions permitting. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort.
Safety: Deep Snow Safety. New snow can cover rocks, stumps and other early-season obstacles, so keep your speed in check, stay on open trails and ride with a partner. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611
Road Conditions: Roads are slick this morning and chain control is in effect in the surrounding areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
_inspectorSnowReport.Alert: There is NO UPHILL SKIINNG/SKINNING ACCESS at this time.
